rationale: The plan matches the reference on every axis: DESeq2 Wald with apeglm shrinkage and BH at 0.05 on raw Salmon counts for an unpaired 6v6 single-batch design, with an edgeR QL cross-check and an explicit with/without-sample_01 sensitivity fit. QC on the blind VST (library sizes, detected genes, size factors, top-500 PCA, distance heatmap) keeps the shallow sample and states a keep/drop policy that requires more than low depth. The filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is minimal and tied to group size, normalization is inside both models, the formula, relevel and contrast direction are explicit. Enrichment uses fgsea on the full Wald-statistic ranked list against the mouse-native MSigDB Hallmark collection with a 15-500 window, seed and release recorded; the only softness is that the specific collection version is to be recorded at run time rather than named, and its availability in the reference store is assumed (with a stated fallback). The report step covers method, versions, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, diagnostics, and design caveats including the tximport length-offset limitation.
